subject: Next steps — technical deep dive & dedicated capacity sizing
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Liu <bethany.liu@finfirm.com>, Rajesh Menon <r.menon@finfirm.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — technical deep dive & dedicated capacity sizing

Hi Bethany / Rajesh,

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to understand FinFirm's high-level use cases and the expected peak profile. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Goal: Run a short technical deep dive (40m) to validate prompt patterns and latency targets, then a dedicated capacity sizing session (60m) to lock throughput and GPU pool needs.
- Success criteria for sizing: sustain 750 concurrent inference requests with p50 latency < 200ms for N=1 short prompts (<=128 tokens) and < 500ms for long prompts (>=1024 tokens).
- Artifacts I'll share before the sizing call: a one-page sizing checklist and a mutual action plan (attached).

Can you confirm availability for the technical deep dive? Proposed slots (PST):
  • Tue Jul 14, 10:00–10:40am
  • Wed Jul 15, 2:30–3:10pm
  • Thu Jul 16, 9:00–9:40am

After we lock the deep dive we'll schedule the dedicated sizing workshop within the following week — Ben (our throughput lead) will run that session. If any of the times above don't work, share 2–3 windows and we'll adapt.

Also, could you paste a short sample prompt or two you'd expect in production (no PII)? That will help Ben tune the load-profile assumptions ahead of the sizing call.

Thanks — look forward to locking a slot.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-sizing-checklist.pdf, FF-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap. Both Rajesh and I are available on Wed Jul 15 at 2:30pm PST (that works best for our engineering lead).

Agenda request: for the deep dive can we spend ~15 minutes on our core prompt flows, ~15 minutes on performance expectations/metrics, and ~10 minutes on immediate next steps for the sizing workshop? That would be ideal for our stakeholders.

Sample prompts (sanitized):
  • "Summarize the following transaction into a single-line description: [transaction_text]" (~80 tokens typical)
  • "Extract entities: customer_name, merchant, amount, transaction_date from message" (~20–40 tokens)

We can drop a calendar invite when you confirm. Looking forward to it.

—Bethany
Bethany Liu
Head of Product, FinFirm
bethany.liu@finfirm.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

1) Short prompt latency (p50/p95) expectations and how prompt shape impacts KV cache and batching.
2) Typical token length distribution and a quick walk-through of your sanitized prompts.
3) Outline of the dedicated sizing workshop: load profile, runbook, and success criteria (I'll send a short pre-read).

Request: after the deep dive, can we block 60–75 minutes that same week for the dedicated sizing workshop? Proposed window: Fri Jul 17, 11:00–12:15pm PST or Mon Jul 20, 9:00–10:15am PST. If either is OK, I'll provision an initial GPU pool and pre-run a lightweight synthetic profile to validate assumptions.

Ben Carter
